question: What is the name of the mascot of the Asia Cup Hockey 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Chand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Nitish Kumar unveils Asia Cup Hockey 2025 logo, mascot, and trophy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Event:** 12th **Men’s Asia Cup Hockey Championship 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
**Host:** **Bihar** for the **first time**, at **Rajgir International Stadium, Rajgir**.

 
 
• 
 
**Launch:** CM **Nitish Kumar** unveiled **logo, mascot, and trophy** in **Patna**.

 
 
• 
 
**Mascot:** **“Chand”** – inspired by **tiger (national animal)** and **Major Dhyan Chand**.

 
 
• 
 
Symbolises **strength, courage, agility, and skill**.

 
 
• 
 
Features: **Red cape** (strength, enthusiasm), **Magician’s hat** (tribute to Dhyan Chand).

 
 
• 
 
Inspired also by **Valmiki Tiger Reserve** of Bihar.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Specials:**

 
 
• 
 
**Trophy Pride Journey** – trophy & torch to travel through all Bihar districts.

 
 
• 
 
Opening on **National Sports Day (29th August)**, birth anniversary of **Dhyan Chand**.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Teams Participating:** **India, China, Japan, Chinese Taipei, Malaysia, South Korea, Oman, Bangladesh**.

 
 
• 
 
**Winner:** Will directly qualify for the **Hockey World Cup**.
